description: This source file is a unit test suite for the TalkDirectiveParser in the OpenClawKit project. It contains multiple test cases validating the parsing of directive JSON strings and their effect on the stripped text output.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveTests
classes.description: A XCTestCase subclass containing test cases for the TalkDirectiveParser, testing JSON directive parsing and handling of various input scenarios.

methods.name: testParsesDirectiveAndStripsLine
methods.description: Tests parsing of a JSON directive with voice and once fields, and checks that the text is correctly stripped.

methods.name: testIgnoresNonDirective
methods.description: Ensures that non-JSON text without directives does not produce a directive and returns the original text.

methods.name: testKeepsDirectiveLineIfNoRecognizedFields
methods.description: Checks that lines with unknown directives are not parsed as directives and are preserved as plain text.

methods.name: testParsesExtendedOptions
methods.description: Validates parsing of extended directive options with various parameters such as voice_id, model_id, rate, stability, etc.

methods.name: testSkipsLeadingEmptyLinesWhenParsingDirective
methods.description: Ensures that leading empty lines do not interfere with directive detection and parsing.

methods.name: testTracksUnknownKeys
methods.description: Verifies that unrecognized keys in the directive JSON are tracked in 'unknownKeys' property.
